description: This Java class defines a command object 'RetrieveConfig' used to retrieve a configuration object from an actor within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes fields, factory methods, JSON serialization/deserialization, and overrides for equality and string representation.

classes.name: RetrieveConfig
classes.description: An immutable command class to retrieve a configuration object, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization, with optional path filtering.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance with null path and empty headers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance with specified path and headers.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the path if set.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command's payload into JSON, including path if present.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new command instance with the provided headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a RetrieveConfig object from a JSON representation.
